notes: Run 1 (2026-10-31) covers the statistical regions Osrednjeslovenska, Gorenjska, Primorsko-notranjska, Obalno-kraška and Goriška; the eastern regions (Podravska, Pomurska, Savinjska, Koroška, Zasavska, Posavska, Jugovzhodna Slovenija) follow in the next run (the VZB register already lists them). Poison line: no animal poison information line found for Slovenia — the national toxicology centre (UKC Ljubljana) serves humans; the Veterinary Faculty small-animal clinic's poisoning FAQ (kmz.si) only tells owners to call a vet urgently, so use the 24-h clinics. National context: since a rulebook change (Uradni list 8 July 2026) private clinics are no longer obliged to run 24-h duty; the ministry (gov.si, 24 July 2026) says emergency help stays guaranteed via the public veterinary network but publishes no duty list, and no VZB/UVHVVR duty-rota page exists. Not verified / left: Bled and Kranjska Gora have no registered practice (nearest Lesce, Jesenice); own sites not opened (robots/bot check/redirect loop): vpt.si (Tenetiše, robots), vpp.si, obutitacek.si, veterinacerknica.si, halovet.si, veterina-idrija.si, elbivet.si, veterinarska-postaja.si; Diagnoza duty number conflicts between site and register; Klinika Loka's role in the Gorenjska rota is inferred ("kolegi iz Škofje Loke"), not stated by name.
